_about: Until daily_from, the old rule: after the first 5 published reels, the days between reels alternate 2, 3, 2, 3... From daily_from (Europe/Madrid date) onwards the factory publishes EVERY day (decided 2026-11-23; credits: Creator plan 121,000/month). daily_from is 2026-12-01, not Monday 11-30, because the weekly plan that sets the topic and the visual storyboard of the week is written on Monday 11-30 at 11:47, after the night run of 11-30.
